## Overview

Runtime registries for operation providers: `MeshBooleanRegistry`,
`MeshPlaneSectionRegistry`, `MeshHiddenLinesRegistry` and
`PointcloudReconstructionRegistry`, each
behind its own feature. A registry owns provider ordering, device matching,
fallback to the next provider, and memory-budget admission. It defines no
request or result types: those live in the operation-contract crates, and
providers implement them without depending on this crate. The `parallel`
feature scopes each dispatched call to a caller-owned CPU pool.

## Changes

Latest release, 0.3.7 (2026-10-28):

### Added

- `MeshPlaneSectionRegistry::section_request`: the source checks of `section`,
  fallback only on unsupported or unavailable providers, and outcome checks of
  the frame, chain and ring invariants, canonical order, budgets (in-plane
  regions, region vertices, in-plane pairs) and evidence counts (ADR 0091,
  #359).
- `MeshPlaneSectionRegistry::register_request_conformant` also runs the
  region suite and rejects a claimed failure (#359).
